title: Backend Engineering Intern (Python) - Northwind Analytics
text:
Northwind Analytics builds forecasting tools for mid-size retailers. Founded in 2017 and headquartered in Islamabad, our team of 40 ships a SaaS platform used by 200+ stores.

We are hiring a Backend Engineering Intern for a 3-month summer internship (June to August), hybrid, 3 days a week in our Blue Area office.

What you'll do: build and test REST endpoints in Python/FastAPI, write SQL against PostgreSQL, and pair with a senior engineer on our ingestion pipeline.

Stipend: PKR 60,000 per month. Laptop provided.

Process: send your CV to careers@northwind-analytics.example. Shortlisted candidates do a 30-minute intro call, a 90-minute technical interview with two engineers, and a short chat with our CTO. Offers are made in writing within a week of the final round.

More about us: https://northwind-analytics.example/about

title: URGENT!!! Remote Data Entry - Earn $500 per day
text:
URGENT HIRING!!! WORK FROM HOME AND EARN up to $500 per day!!! No experience needed, students welcome. Simple copy-paste data entry, 2 hours a day.

Limited slots, apply today only. You will be hired immediately, no interview required.

To start, contact our HR manager on Telegram @GlobalRemoteHR. Selected candidates must pay a one-time registration fee of $49 for the training kit (fully refundable after your first week).

For payroll setup please send a copy of your CNIC and your bank account details to globalremote.hr.team@gmail.com. Salary is paid weekly in USDT crypto.

ACT NOW!!!

title: Junior Full-Stack Developer - PixelForge Studio
text:
PixelForge Studio is a fast-growing creative agency looking for a Junior Full-Stack Developer (React + Node) to join our remote team.

We offer a competitive salary and growth opportunities in a friendly team.

How to apply: send your GitHub to pixelforge.hiring@gmail.com. Shortlisted applicants will complete an unpaid trial project lasting 2 weeks, building a feature for one of our live client websites. Successful candidates will be onboarded after the trial.

All communication after the first email happens on WhatsApp for speed. Immediate start.

title: Machine Learning Intern (Remote) - Lumen Health AI
text:
Lumen Health AI builds triage models for rural clinics across South Asia. Our company was founded in 2019 and is backed by two impact funds.

Role: Machine Learning Intern, fully remote, 6 months, 30 hours/week.

You will: clean and label clinical text data, train and evaluate small transformer models with PyTorch, and write evaluation reports.

Compensation: USD 400 per month, paid via bank transfer through our payroll provider.

Process: apply at https://lumenhealth.example/careers. We run a paid 3-hour take-home (compensated USD 40), then a 45-minute technical interview and a final interview with the ML lead. We never ask for fees or ID documents before a signed offer.
